entrance.title_zh: 让每个说不清的情绪，都能被看见、被理解。
entrance.title_en: Let every feeling that is hard to name be seen and understood.
entrance.body_zh: 我用画面、声音和互动，做一些可以亲手触碰、也可以一次次回到的小世界。它们从那些还没有名字的感受开始，把最后的解释留给你。
entrance.body_en: I use visual imagery, sound, and interaction to make small worlds you can touch and return to again and again. They begin with feelings that do not yet have a name, while leaving the final meaning with you.
core_positioning_zh: 开发 → 自动化测试 → 数据产品经理。
我习惯把复杂的系统变得可见，却越来越在意那些没有接口、没有日志、说也说不清的感受。
于是，我开始把画面、声音和互动做成一个个小世界，让那些说不清的感受，暂时有地方停留。
core_positioning_en: Development → QA automation → data product management.
I learned to make complex systems visible, then became more interested in feelings with no interface, no logs, and no easy name.
So I began shaping images, sound, and interaction into small worlds—places where feelings that are hard to name can stay for a while.

flagship_works.note_zh: 雨是一道幕。捏住它的边往左拉，缝后面是晚霞、电车和十只麻雀。
flagship_works.note_en: Pinch the edge of the rain and pull left. Through the opening: sunset, a tram, and ten sparrows.

zh.label: 它接住什么
zh.text: 雨幕遮住晚霞、电车和麻雀，等待被亲手拉开。

zh.label: 用户必须做什么
zh.text: 捏住雨幕右缘，向左拖出一道缝。

zh.label: 系统如何判断
zh.text: 开口宽度跟随拖动幅度，松手后开始合拢。

zh.label: 世界怎样回应
zh.text: 晚霞、电车和麻雀在缝中出现，雨声随拉开幅度变轻。

zh.label: 为什么只能这样交互
zh.text: 开口需要手指维持；松手后雨幕慢慢合拢。

en.label: What it holds
en.text: A curtain of rain hides a sunset, a tram, and sparrows until it is pulled aside.

en.label: What the visitor must do
en.text: Pinch the right edge of the rain and drag it left.

en.label: How the system decides
en.text: The opening follows the drag distance and begins to close after release.

en.label: How the world responds
en.text: Sunset, a tram, and sparrows appear through the gap as the rain grows quieter.

en.label: Why this interaction must be this way
en.text: The opening needs a hand to hold it; release lets the curtain slowly close.

flagship_works.note_zh: 把潮湿和心事挂起来，让它们慢慢落成一池雨。
flagship_works.note_en: Hang up the dampness and the thoughts you carry, and let them fall slowly into a pool of rain.

zh.label: 它接住什么
zh.text: 两朵潮湿的云挂在庭院里，下方是一方石池。

zh.label: 用户必须做什么
zh.text: 按住云朵，或在云上拖动。

zh.label: 系统如何判断
zh.text: 触点成为云的临时低点，持续按压使云体下陷。

zh.label: 世界怎样回应
zh.text: 雨水沿新的低点落入池中，留下水花和涟漪。

zh.label: 为什么只能这样交互
zh.text: 松手后云朵回弹，延迟落下的雨滴让水面慢慢回静。

en.label: What it holds
en.text: Two damp clouds hang in a courtyard above a stone pool.

en.label: What the visitor must do
en.text: Hold a cloud or drag across its surface.

en.label: How the system decides
en.text: The touch becomes a temporary low point, and sustained pressure draws the cloud down.

en.label: How the world responds
en.text: Rain falls from the new low point into the pool, leaving splashes and ripples.

en.label: Why this interaction must be this way
en.text: Release lets the cloud spring back; a delayed raindrop carries the pool back toward stillness.

flagship_works.note_zh: 把天气一件件晾上去，再一件件摘下来。
flagship_works.note_en: Hang the weather up, one piece at a time. Then take it down again.

zh.label: 它接住什么
zh.text: 一间紫色卧室，床头晾着七块天气布。

zh.label: 用户必须做什么
zh.text: 拨动布片，向下摘下，再拎回空着的夹位。

zh.label: 系统如何判断
zh.text: 拖动位置与受力决定布片的摆动、脱落和重新挂回。

zh.label: 世界怎样回应
zh.text: 绳、夹子和天气布一起晃动，布可以落在床上或地板上。

zh.label: 为什么只能这样交互
zh.text: 没有整理目标或计分，摘下与挂回都由来访者决定。

en.label: What it holds
en.text: Seven pieces of weather cloth hang above the bed in a purple room.

en.label: What the visitor must do
en.text: Nudge a cloth, pull it down, then carry it back to an empty clip.

en.label: How the system decides
en.text: Drag position and force determine how the cloth swings, falls, and hangs again.

en.label: How the world responds
en.text: Rope, clips, and cloth sway together; cloth can land on the bed or floor.

en.label: Why this interaction must be this way
en.text: There is no tidying target or score. The visitor chooses what to take down and hang again.

responsive_worlds.reason_zh: 一只童年屏保里的鱼缸，因为记忆被保存，才值得被再次打开。
responsive_worlds.reason_en: A childhood screensaver aquarium is worth reopening because it keeps a memory of the visit.
responsive_worlds.action_zh: 主要动作：投食、轻叩玻璃、停下来观察。
responsive_worlds.action_en: Primary gesture: feed, tap the glass softly, and stay to watch.
responsive_worlds.response_zh: 回应方式：鱼群、声音与保存下来的来访痕迹一起改变。
responsive_worlds.response_en: Response: the fish, sound, and retained traces of a visit change together.

responsive_worlds.reason_zh: 它把一次掠过树冠的手势留成沿枝传播的风，因此每次重访都能重新开始一阵辽阔。
responsive_worlds.reason_en: A gesture over its canopy becomes wind travelling through branches, so every return can begin another small expanse.
responsive_worlds.action_en: Primary gesture: brush across the canopy.
responsive_worlds.response_zh: 回应方式：风、叶与五声音阶沿距离逐段传开。
responsive_worlds.response_en: Response: wind, leaves, and pentatonic sound travel outward by distance.

responsive_worlds.reason_zh: 它是一只可被照料的瓶：种子并不需要被催熟，回来看一眼就是一次允许。
responsive_worlds.reason_en: It is a bottle that can be cared for: seeds do not need to be rushed, and looking in again is itself permission.
responsive_worlds.action_zh: 主要动作：触碰或按住一颗琥珀晶种。
responsive_worlds.action_en: Primary gesture: touch or hold an amber seed.
responsive_worlds.response_zh: 回应方式：晶种短暂发芽，萤光触角与涟漪在玻璃内出现。
responsive_worlds.response_en: Response: a seed briefly sprouts; luminous tendrils and ripples appear inside the glass.

responsive_worlds.reason_zh: 夜晚被缩小到一只钟罩里；它不要求完成什么，只等下一次轻轻敲门。
responsive_worlds.reason_en: Night is reduced to a bell jar. It asks for no completion, only waits for the next gentle knock.
responsive_worlds.action_en: Primary gesture: touch the bell jar.
responsive_worlds.response_zh: 回应方式：月苔苏醒，微光与潮汐式波纹向外扩散。
responsive_worlds.response_en: Response: moon moss wakes, sending glow and tide-like waves outward.

responsive_worlds.reason_zh: 风车在听，风铃在回答；它像一处可以步入的天气，而不是一次性的展示。
responsive_worlds.reason_en: The windmill listens and wind chimes answer; it is weather one can enter, not a one-time display.
responsive_worlds.action_zh: 主要动作：走进山谷，靠近风与风铃。
responsive_worlds.action_en: Primary gesture: enter the valley and move toward wind and chimes.
responsive_worlds.response_zh: 回应方式：风车、风铃与环境声彼此接力。
responsive_worlds.response_en: Response: windmill, chimes, and ambient sound hand the reply from one to another.

responsive_worlds.reason_zh: 情绪不必马上被命名；选一种天气，给自己六十秒重新吸气，是可以反复使用的日记入口。
responsive_worlds.reason_en: An emotion need not be named at once. Choosing weather and taking sixty seconds to breathe is a diary entrance designed for return.
responsive_worlds.action_zh: 主要动作：选择天气，开始或结束 60 秒呼吸。
responsive_worlds.action_en: Primary gesture: choose weather, then begin or end a 60-second breath.
responsive_worlds.response_zh: 回应方式：玻璃小屋的气象、像素粒子与环境音随心境切换。
responsive_worlds.response_en: Response: weather, pixel particles, and ambient sound shift inside the glass room.

workbenches.role_zh: 从难以命名的感受出发，寻找一个只有亲手完成才有意义的动作。
workbenches.role_en: Starts with a feeling that is hard to name, then finds an action that only means something when a person completes it.
workbenches.flow_zh: 感受 → 隐喻 → 不可替代动作 → 回应状态
workbenches.flow_en: Feeling → metaphor → irreplaceable action → response state

workbenches.members_zh: content-creation-router / inner-voice / echo-caption / spotform / social-video-editor / h5-publish
workbenches.members_en: content-creation-router / inner-voice / echo-caption / spotform / social-video-editor / h5-publish
workbenches.role_zh: 把灵感交给适合的创作工具，同时把最后的决定留在创作者手里。
workbenches.role_en: Gives each idea to the right creative tool while leaving the final decision with the creator.
workbenches.flow_zh: 输入 → 场景判断 → handoff → 专业执行器 → 用户确认
workbenches.flow_en: Input → scene judgment → handoff → specialist executor → user confirmation

workbenches.role_zh: 分清事实、推断与待验证，让增长不盖过真实读者和作品本身。
workbenches.role_en: Keeps facts, inferences, and open questions separate so growth never eclipses real readers or the work itself.
workbenches.flow_zh: 事实 → 推断 → 待验证 → 单变量实验 → 真实复盘
workbenches.flow_en: Facts → inference → to be verified → single-variable experiment → real retrospective

rejections.en: I do not treat missing data as `0`.

rejections.zh: 不把发布完成写成增长成立。
rejections.en: I do not write a completed publication as proof that growth happened.

rejections.zh: 不替用户确认创作意图。
rejections.en: I do not confirm a user’s creative intent on their behalf.

rejections.zh: 不让公式替代真实读者目标。
rejections.en: I do not let a formula replace a real reader goal.

rejections.zh: 不让点击成为没有隐喻意义的特效。
rejections.en: I do not let a click become an effect with no metaphorical meaning.

rejections.zh: 不用万能 Agent 掩盖专业判断的缺失。
rejections.en: I do not use a one-size-fits-all Agent to conceal the absence of professional judgment.

path.body_zh: 开发 → 自动化测试 → 数据产品经理 → 用技术把感受与创作变成可以被体验的东西
path.body_en: Development → QA automation → data product management → using technology to turn feelings and creative ideas into experiences
